sloka: सुधृतेः अपि धर्मात्मा धृष्टकेतुः सु धार्मिकः ।धृष्टकेतोः च राजर्षेः हर्यश्व इति विश्रुतः ॥१-७१-८॥
transliteration: sudhṛteḥ api dharmātmā dhṛṣṭaketuḥ su dhārmikaḥ ।dhṛṣṭaketoḥ ca rājarṣeḥ haryaśva iti viśrutaḥ ॥1-71-8॥

translations.english: To Sudhruti was born the righteous Drishtaketu, committed to dharma. Rajarshi Drishtaketu was father to the wellknown Haryasva.
